reason: I already find things through my WhatsApp groups, and I go because I know who is going. A feed of events full of strangers does not fix the actual problem, which is that I am not showing up to a yoga class alone.
objection: Seeing 'who else is going' means nothing if they are all strangers. I trust my hiking group chat, not a list of profiles on an app.
would_change_my_mind: If my existing groups, like my hiking or language exchange chats, started posting their events there and I could see people I actually know attending, I would download it and probably buy a concert ticket through it eventually.
